Reason: HIF-1alpha donor peptide requires hydroxyproline (HYP@564) for pVHL recognition -- this is the defining, biologically essential modification for the VHL-HIF1alpha interaction (non-hydroxylated HIF1alpha does not bind pVHL), not an incidental crystallization aid like MSE. Reason: CBP's Nuclear Coactivator Binding Domain (NCBD, chain C/D/F/H, residues 2065-2111) is a classic 'coupled folding and binding' IDP domain -- it has no fixed native fold on its own and only becomes a stable three-helix bundle in complex with a partner (like IRF-3's C-terminal domain here, or ACTR/p53TAD2 in other complexes). This breaks the folded-acceptor assumption entirely: there is no independently stable scaffold to anchor Go-model domain restraints on.
Rescue: Not obviously rescuable within this pipeline without a dedicated mutual/coupled-folding treatment (neither partner is a fixed reference structure on its own).

Reason: Cryo-EM structure of the entire yeast 80S ribosome (18S rRNA + ~17 ribosomal proteins) with eEF2 bound -- a massive macromolecular machine, not an extractable folded-acceptor + disordered-SLiM pair. Rescue: Not rescuable; find a dedicated structure for the actual domain-motif pair the ELM instance describes, if one exists, rather than this ribosome assembly.
